title: LibreDWG XREF, annotative-context, DIMASSOC, and block-body crosswalk
mode: Current primary-source peer review plus local source/spec/test crosswalk; plan-only
scope: Read the full current reports for LibreDWG PRs #1431, #1432, and #1434 and distinguish their input/output operations and evidence ceilings.
Trace XREF BLOCK_HEADER read/write state, standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA adapter publication, and DIMASSOC test coverage in the local worktree.
Compare the recent block-body and INSERT/ATTRIB issue reports with existing generated tests and refresh peer-status handling.
Refine existing PAR-65, PAR-20, and PAR-45 implementation owners without promoting format-support claims or changing validation cadence.

sources.project: Autodesk DXF BLOCK reference and ODA DWG specification
sources.revision: Autodesk BLOCK DXF table opened 2026-10-19; local ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.52 read. Local filename has a '(1)' suffix unlike the unsuffixed AGENTS.md path.
sources.observed: Autodesk documents BLOCK group 70 XREF-related flags and group 1 path. ODA §20.4.52 documents versioned BLOCK_HEADER flags/index/path and handle-stream fields.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Normative guidance for field layout; implementation still requires version-specific local vectors and, for semantic qualification, independent producer/reader evidence.

localEvidence: DRW_Block_Record stores flags, xrefPath, and xrefBlockHandle, but parseDwg reads xrefindex+1 into a temporary and does not retain it.

dwgRW::defineBlock accepts only name, base point, and insertion units. The shared dwgWriter15::emitBlockRecord writes XREF/resolved/overlay flags as zero, an empty path, and a null external-reference pointer; output writer wrappers inherit the serializer.

readDwgObject publishes standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA as a DRW_ObjectContextData shell and an unsupported raw frame. The compatibility callback is a no-op; dx_iface has no context-data collection and its unsupported-object capture retains only selected EvalGraph/ACSH-history records.

Existing generated block-owner controls cover consecutive named/anonymous/paper blocks, compound INSERT children, record/body cardinality and ASCII/Binary output; this is not a real DWG-to-DXF cross-route reproduction.

Existing DIMASSOC local work owns semantic 70/71 correction and bounded osnap-detail handling; the precise multi-reference/order vector must be checked against the current focused inventory before adding one generated case.

assessment.planImpact: Adds an implementation-ready DWG XREF writer slice under PAR-65/7AM, folds standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA adapter loss into PAR-20/7F.1, and sharpens the existing PAR-45/7AA multi-reference test gate. Peer PRs remain non-normative and no new top-level finding or support claim is created.

method.kind: Read-only public GitHub/Autodesk review plus local source, existing-test, and ODA-spec crosswalk
method.limitations: The LibreDWG PR results are author-reported and unmerged. The local source review confirms two conversion loss routes but does not exercise a real producer drawing. ODA §20.4.52 is the DWG layout authority; new serializer behavior still needs version-specific generated checks and later independent/native qualification at existing composed gates.
